## Free Threading in CPython 3.13 and Extension Support

CPython 3.13 introduced experimental free threading as a configuration that can run with the GIL disabled. In this mode, an imported extension’s support declaration affects runtime behavior: if the extension has no explicit declaration, CPython warns and enables the GIL.

The way an extension declares support differs between multi-phase and single-phase initialization. For extension authors, making that declaration is a compatibility responsibility. It communicates support for the free-threaded mode; it does not make the extension’s code thread-safe or establish that it is.
